exposure: Gestational complications in the first pregnancy
Perinatal complications in the first pregnancy
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 66 adolescents who experienced 2 deliveries during their adolescence
finding: Second pregnancies of adolescents were associated with fewer adverse perinatal outcomes than their first pregnancies, but factors like maternal age at first pregnancy and short interbirth intervals increased the risk of adverse outcomes in the second pregnancy.
birth_weight: Similar between first and second pregnancies
